name: Hour marks
content:
# --- Draw Hour Markers ---
COLOR NAME=BLACK
# Use solid color for markers
FILL NAME=SOLID 
VAR $hourDegree
VAR $centerX
VAR $centerY
LET $centerX=$width/2
LET $centerY=$height/2
REPEAT COUNT=12 TIMES
   RESET_TRANSFORMS
   # Center origin (assuming 200x200 display)
   TRANSLATE DX=$centerX DY=$centerY 
   # Rotate per hour (uses $INDEX and 30º)
   LET $hourDegree=$index*30
   ROTATE DEGREES=$hourDegree
   # Move out
   TRANSLATE DX=0 DY=-90 
   # Draw marker
   FILL_RECT X=0 Y=0 WIDTH=6 HEIGHT=10 
ENDREPEAT
